channel.title: Cat on a Hot Tin Roof
channel.desc: A Southern family's internal crisis is distilled in the turbulent relationship of a wife and husband, Maggie `The Cat' and Brick Pollitt, and their interactions with Brick's family over the course of a weekend gathering at the family estate in Mississippi, held to celebrate the birthday of patriarch and tycoon `Big Daddy' Pollitt.
